description: Labeled set for measuring the grounding-judge's own accuracy (precision/recall/F1 for the 'ungrounded' class). Categories: fact (verbatim support), numeric_inference, temporal_inference, transitive_inference, paraphrase_inference (all should be judged grounded), unsupported, contradiction (should be judged ungrounded).
